# Q1 — Avatar request path (browser → stored data)

The avatar is served by the plain-HTTP file server (Echo), not by gRPC.

**Hop 0 — URL construction (why the browser asks for this path)**
- `convertUserFromStore` — `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_service_converters.go:16`, and specifically line 36: `userpb.AvatarUrl = fmt.Sprintf("/file/%s/avatar", userpb.Name)` when the stored `AvatarURL` is a base64 data URI. `userpb.Name` is `BuildUserName(user.Username)` = `"users/" + username` (`/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/user_resource_name.go:14`, prefix at `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/resource_name.go:18`). So the emitted URL is `/file/users/{username}/avatar`.

**Hop 1 — service construction + route registration**
- `fileserver.NewFileServerService` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:107`; wired in `NewServer` at `/bench/repo/server/server.go:81`.
- `(*FileServerService).RegisterRoutes` — `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:118`; called at `/bench/repo/server/server.go:82`.
- Actual route: `/bench/repo/server/router/fileserver/fileserver.go:124` — `fileGroup.GET("/users/:identifier/avatar", s.serveUserAvatar)` on group `/file` (`fileserver.go:123`). Only global middleware applies (`middleware.Recover`, `newCORSMiddleware`) — `/bench/repo/server/server.go:51-52`. No auth middleware on this group.

**Hop 2 — handler**
